claimed_scope: Build the smallest deterministic, persistence-agnostic Recursive Cognitive Process Distillation primitive for Frankenstein 2.0. It consumes only explicit caller-supplied typed process evidence (process identity/generation, ordered step references, outcome classification, falsifier/failure references, transfer-condition references and provenance) and emits a frozen process-pattern candidate plus deterministic digest. It may compress repeated explicit structure but must never infer facts, semantic correctness, causality, success, method validity, transfer applicability, canonical truth, authority, effects or completion. Candidate formation must require exact process identity/generation and nonempty evidence references; recursive composition may reference prior candidate digests only with explicit acyclic parent links and bounded depth. No payload inspection, retrieval ranking, UnifiedDB reads/writes, provider/model/tool calls, VPS execution, physical GRID10 credit or whole-system credit. Source plus deterministic fail-closed tests and repository-hosted CI only.
